body:
Private Photo Vault is a popular iPhone photo-hiding app. Safey covers the same need and adds passwords, notes and files — free. Here's how they compare, honestly.

Safey vs Private Photo Vault at a glance

Competitor details can change — check the current App Store listing before deciding.

Where they differ most

What you can store. Private Photo Vault focuses on photos and videos. Safey is an all-in-one vault: photos, videos, passwords, cards, notes and files together.

Price. Safey's vault is free with no ads; Private Photo Vault is freemium.

Privacy under pressure. Both offer a decoy and break-in capture. In Safey, the decoy passcode opens a separate empty vault, and break-in alerts photograph anyone who fails your code.

Which should you choose?

If you only want to hide photos and like Private Photo Vault's approach, it's a fine choice. If you want one free app for everything private on your iPhone — with strong on-device encryption — Safey is the better fit. Compare more options in our best photo vault apps guide.
